subject: [hw] P04 -> IP: 4 objects for build_ios.sh, the include path, the 2-line SLIMEncoderRegister hook, symbols.txt
body:
P04 is complete on the host (N2TEST P04 PASS 5029/5029) and compiles for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with your exact build_ios.sh flags. Three changes are needed from you; nothing else in your script.

1) INCS: add -I "$HERE/vt" next to the other -I lines (the p04 headers are there). client/ already contributes -I "$HERE/client" when it exists, and vt/n2hwenc_client.c includes client/n2vcd_client.h through __has_include (it also compiles without client/, so the object is safe either way).

2) Objects (after the jpeg plug-in block; PLUGIN_OBJS is what gpu/video links into Slim.videoencoder):
   echo "== compiling the VideoToolbox hardware encoder objects (P04) =="
   for src in annexb.c n2hwenc_vt.c n2hwenc_client.c n2hwenc_register.c; do
   	compile "$HERE/vt/$src" "$OUT/obj/${src%.c}.o"
   	OBJECTS+=("$OUT/obj/${src%.c}.o")
   	PLUGIN_OBJS+=("$OUT/obj/${src%.c}.o")
   done
   My own check of exactly those four compiles is inside gpu/hwcodec/vt/test/run_tests.sh (it prints 'P04 ios compile: 4/4 objects for arm64-apple-ios16.0'); it uses -isystem gpu/video/sdk/sysinc -I gpu/video/include -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/client -I gpu/hwcodec/vt and -Werror.

3) Registration hook in gpu/video/vt/n2vt_shim.c (read-only for both of us; route to hw-lead if you agree). Next to the other weak externs:
   extern int n2hwenc_register_all(void) N2_WEAK;   /* P04: hardware avc1/hvc1 objects */
and in n2_register_all(), after the 'VTRegisterVideoEncoderWithInfo is NULL' check:
   if (n2hwenc_register_all != NULL)
   	n2vt_say("hardware encoders registered: %d", n2hwenc_register_all());
n2hwenc_register_all() registers 'avc1', 'hvc1' and 'hev1' with ImplementationID ours, IsHardwareAccelerated true and Rating 100 (software objects register without a rating), returns how many succeeded (0 when VideoToolbox is absent), and never prints. IF YOU PREFER NOT TO OFFER THE HARDWARE ENCODER BEFORE M4c, gate that call on a switch file (e.g. /private/var/db/nord2-video-hwenc) in the shim; the object itself is unconditional. My recommendation is the gate until the VENC actually encodes on the phone: with vcodecd absent the object answers kVTVideoEncoderNotAvailableNowErr at StartSession and VideoToolbox falls back, but that retry is [I], not measured, and a failed encoder selection must not break Camera recording.

4) gpu/hwcodec/vt/symbols.txt lists every framework/libSystem symbol my objects import (CoreFoundation, CoreMedia including CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets, CoreVideo, VideoToolbox including VTRegisterVideoEncoderWithInfo/kVTVideoEncoder_IsHardwareAccelerated/kVTVideoEncoder_Rating, libSystem). It also names the weak P03 imports. Use it when you extend sdk_symbols.txt/the link check; the only CoreMedia name that is not in gpu/video's stubs yet is CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets (ask to hw-lead, I declared it in vt/n2hwenc_vt.h meanwhile).

Acceptance command on this side: bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST P04 PASS 5029/5029. After your two lines are in, the product claim becomes 'linked into Slim.videoencoder'; the phone claim stays with the main session.
